quote: We show that INSTRUCTIONALFINGERPRINT effectively fingerprints 11 different LLMs and successfully verifies ownership even after significant user fine-tuning.

We now introduce our proposed INSTRUCTIONALFINGERPRINT (IF) method. Our preliminary experiments with prior works on fingerprinting via poison suggest that LLMs struggle to recall specific fingerprint pairs (x, y) after extensive fine-tuning ( §4.1).
